parole.significato: A citrus fruit that is a cross between an orange and a grapefruit.
parole.testo: Blend of orange + pomelo. Calque of Puerto Rican Spanish chironja, itself a blend of china (“orange”) + toronja (“grapefruit”).

parole.significato: A Puerto Rican frozen dessert, shaped like a pyramid, made of shaved ice and covered with fruit-flavored syrup.
parole.testo: From Puerto Rican Spanish piragua, from pirámide (“pyramid”) + agua (“water”).
